item.title: Clearer next steps for persistent symptoms
item.summary: When a safe daily-life change could help clarify a recurring symptom pattern, Murph now recommends one bounded first trial instead of a generic list of wellness tips.
item.details: Each trial names the exact action, duration, what to notice, stop conditions, and review point. Murph still asks a safety-changing question or routes to appropriate care when self-management is not the right first step.
